patterns.message: errors.ts, call-options.ts, random.ts and until-aborted.ts depend on nothing.
core is the lowest package of the family: it imports no other.
formats.ts, json.ts and findings.ts depend on nothing of the package.
core is the lowest package of the family: it imports no other.
checks.ts depends only on errors.ts, findings.ts, formats.ts and json.ts.
core is the lowest package of the family: it imports no other.
clock.ts depends only on errors.ts and checks.ts.
core is the lowest package of the family: it imports no other.
service.ts depends only on errors.ts, checks.ts, call-options.ts and until-aborted.ts.
core is the lowest package of the family: it imports no other.
core is the lowest package of the family: it imports no other.
signer/ depends only on call-options.ts, checks.ts, errors.ts and until-aborted.ts.
core is the lowest package of the family: it imports no other.
oauth/ builds on the files of src/ and on the signer module, through its index.ts or internal.ts.
core is the lowest package of the family: it imports no other.
http/ depends only on errors.ts, checks.ts and json.ts.
core is the lowest package of the family: it imports no other.
protocol/ builds on errors.ts and @interopkit/core only: the tool and platform roles build on it.
claims/ imports no other folder of protocol/: the message model and the token rules build on it.
A service folder of protocol/ builds on claims/ and @interopkit/core only, and never imports another folder of protocol/.
message/ builds on claims/ and @interopkit/core only: the service folders and the token rules never meet it.
tool/ builds on errors.ts, protocol/ and @interopkit/core only: it never imports platform/.
platform/ builds on errors.ts, protocol/ and @interopkit/core only: it never imports tool/.
model/ holds the terms and imports none of build/, read/, send/, validate/, endpoint/ and v1p1/: they build on it.
v1p1/ holds what differs in Caliper 1.1 and builds on model/ and @interopkit/core only: read/, validate/ and endpoint/ build on it.
read/ builds on model/ and @interopkit/core only: build/, send/, validate/ and endpoint/ build on it.
validate/ builds on model/, read/ and @interopkit/core only: build/ and endpoint/ build on it, and send/ never imports it.
build/ builds on model/, read/, validate/ and @interopkit/core only: send/ and endpoint/ never import it, and the 1.1 is read and never written.
send/ builds on model/, build/ and @interopkit/core only: it never imports endpoint/, which is the other side of the wire, nor v1p1/, since 1.1 is read and never written.
endpoint/ builds on model/, read/, validate/ and @interopkit/core only: it never imports send/, which is the other side of the wire, nor build/.
model/ holds the types and terms and imports no other module of the package: they build on it.
read/ builds on model/ and @interopkit/core only: version/, graph/ and client/ are its siblings and provider/ builds on it.
version/ builds on model/ and @interopkit/core only: read/, graph/ and client/ are its siblings and provider/ builds on it.
provider/ builds on model/, read/, version/ and @interopkit/core only: graph/ and client/ are its siblings and never a layer under it.
client/ builds on model/, read/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings and never a layer under it.
graph/ builds on model/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings and never a layer under it.
model/ holds the types and terms and imports no other module: they build on it.
read/ builds on model/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it, and are never a layer under it.
issue/ builds on model/, read/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it, and are never a layer under it.
keys/ builds on model/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it, and are never a layer under it.
jwt/ builds on model/, read/, keys/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it, and are never a layer under it.
data-integrity/ builds on model/, read/, keys/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it, and are never a layer under it.
status/ builds on model/, read/, keys/, jwt/, data-integrity/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it, and are never a layer under it.
refresh/ builds on model/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it, and are never a layer under it.
compare/ builds on model/, read/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it, and are never a layer under it.
baking/ builds on model/, read/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it, and are never a layer under it.
verify/ builds on model/, read/, keys/, jwt/, data-integrity/, status/, refresh/, compare/, issue/ and @interopkit/core only: baking/ and client/ are its siblings and never a layer under it.
client/ builds on model/, read/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it, and are never a layer under it.
provider/ builds on model/, read/, jwt/, verify/ and @interopkit/core only, and loads the index of verify/ on demand: the other modules are its siblings or below verify/.
model/ holds the types, the terms and the data types and imports no module that builds on it.
read/ builds on model/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules build on it.
build/ builds on model/, read/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it.
compare/ builds on model/, read/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it.
format/ builds on model/, read/ and @interopkit/core only: the other modules are its siblings or build on it.
attachments/ builds on model/, read/ and @interopkit/core only: signing/ builds on it.
signing/ builds on model/, read/, compare/, attachments/ and @interopkit/core only.
client/ builds on model/, read/, compare/, attachments/ and @interopkit/core only.
store/ builds on model/, read/, compare/, format/, attachments/, signing/ and @interopkit/core only.
proof-value/ is a layer under base/, derive/ and verify/ and a sibling of the other two bottom modules: it imports none of them.
keys/ is a layer under base/, derive/ and verify/ and a sibling of the other two bottom modules: it imports none of them.
document/ is a layer under base/, derive/ and verify/ and a sibling of the other two bottom modules: it imports none of them.
base/ builds on proof-value/, keys/ and document/ only: base/, derive/ and verify/ are siblings and never a layer under one another.
derive/ builds on proof-value/, keys/ and document/ only: base/, derive/ and verify/ are siblings and never a layer under one another.
verify/ builds on proof-value/, keys/ and document/ only: base/, derive/ and verify/ are siblings and never a layer under one another.
